title: From mononuclear to pyrazine-bridged dinuclear samarium(III) complexes: role of fluxidentate coordination in luminescent and thermal behavior

Three Sm(III)-complexes featuring β-diketone ligand 4,4,4-trifluoro-1-thienyl-1,3-butadionate (TTBD) were studied for their potential as visible-light emitters.
